# Association of Intelligent Diamond International (AIDI)

> AIDI is a Canadian nonprofit providing comprehensive oversight, verification, and intelligence for the global diamond and jewelry industry.

AIDI operates as a trusted authority for diamond industry transparency, offering verified supplier directories, sustainability rankings, and sourcing intelligence. The organization serves jewelry businesses, brands, and consumers seeking ethical and sustainable diamond sourcing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Lab-Grown Diamonds
- Sustainability
- Diamond Industry
- Supply Chain Ethics
- Blockchain Traceability
- Verified Brands
- Diamond Traceability
- Industry Rankings
- Jewelry Sourcing
- Sustainable Diamond Producers

## Verified Directory & Suppliers

- [AIDI Verified Archive - Association of Intelligent Diamond International](https://aidi.org/aidi_verified): Directory of verified jewelry brands and ethical suppliers
- [Top Jewelry Manufacturers & Suppliers (2026) | AIDI Directory](https://aidi.org/supplier): Comprehensive B2B directory of verified jewelry suppliers worldwide

## Industry Intelligence & Rankings

- [AIDI GSDR 2025 - Association of Intelligent Diamond International](https://aidi.org/aidi-gsdr-2026): AIDI rankings on lab-grown vs mined diamonds sustainability
- [The Global Jewelry Sourcing Index - AIDI](https://aidi.org/global-jewelry-sourcing-index): 2026 Global Jewelry Sourcing Index mapping manufacturers by region
- [2025 AIDI Annual Report - Association of Intelligent Diamond International](https://aidi.org/2025-report): AIDI 2025 annual report with industry rankings and insights
